# Lucky Please robots.txt
# Sitemap: https://luckyplz.com/sitemap.xml

# ============================================================
# Default policy — allow everything for general search engines.
# ============================================================
User-agent: *
Allow: /
# --- Auto-generated daily market posts (thin/programmatic) -------------
# The us/kr/cn open-brief, close-brief, premarket and tech-recap dailies
# (plus baseball/football/worldcup dailies) are template-generated,
# near-duplicate, and ephemeral. They carry a `noindex` meta tag and are
# excluded from the sitemap and from the on-site browse/index.
#
# IMPORTANT — these are intentionally LEFT CRAWLABLE (no Disallow).
# A robots.txt `Disallow` would PREVENT Googlebot from fetching the page,
# which means it can never SEE the `noindex` tag — so already-indexed thin
# posts would get stuck as "Indexed, though blocked by robots.txt" and
# never drop out of Google's quality evaluation. To actually remove them
# from the index (the goal after the AdSense "low value content" flags),
# Googlebot must be allowed to crawl, read `noindex`, and de-index them.
# Direct-link sharing (auto-publish notifications) keeps working.
# Manual analysis in the stocks category (e.g. ppi-10-prints,
# ai-power-supply) is NOT noindexed and stays fully indexable.

# ============================================================
# AI crawlers — explicit allow.
# We've already seen referral traffic from chatgpt.com / perplexity
# in GA4 (May 2026), so these channels are real. Keeping them
# explicit here makes the intent unambiguous to the crawlers
# themselves, since some prefer an explicit allow over inheriting
# from "User-agent: *".
# ============================================================
User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Allow: /

User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Perplexity-User
Allow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Allow: /

User-agent: anthropic-ai
Allow: /

User-agent: cohere-ai
Allow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /

User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Allow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Allow: /

User-agent: meta-externalagent
Allow: /

User-agent: Bytespider
Allow: /

# ============================================================
# Aggressive SEO scrapers — block.
# These bots hammer the site for backlink data they then sell to
# their paying customers, without giving anything back. They eat
# CDN bandwidth without producing referral traffic. Blocking them
# frees up crawl budget for real visitors and the AI crawlers
# above.
# ============================================================
User-agent: SemrushBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: AhrefsBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: MJ12bot
Disallow: /

User-agent: DotBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: BLEXBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: PetalBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: SeznamBot
Disallow: /

# ============================================================
# Sitemap — points to the canonical sitemap.xml at the root.
# Google / Bing / Yandex / Baidu all read this directive.
# ============================================================
Sitemap: https://luckyplz.com/sitemap.xml
